title: Positive space bounds and their successors
statement: Let $s : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ satisfy $s(n)>0$ for every $n$. Then the class of binary languages decidable with space bounded by a constant multiple of $s(n)$ equals the class decidable with space bounded by a constant multiple of $s(n)+1$.
